Project_Description: Single-file, dependency-free browser editor for BEJSON (104/104a/105/105a) and MFDB manifest/entity documents, with full MFDB folder discovery, multi-file/folder loading, File System Access API mount-and-save-back, ZIP export, and full 105-series schema-constraint support (required/unique/enum/min/max/minLength/maxLength) via a dynamic per-row constraint-list UI. Delivered as two build variants of one project: the full build (104/104a/105/105a) and a 104-only build (104/104a, no 105-series at all). No 104db or 105db support in either variant -- both are explicitly, permanently out of scope.
Values: Two-variant browser BEJSON/MFDB editor project, now with full MFDB folder discovery/loading/mount/export and a dynamic per-row 105-series schema-constraint editor.
